description: Land Titile Settlement Department -  Mehiella, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on property rights and land title settlements, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
